title: proof_graph.json
description: Structured proof artefact a participant harness must produce alongside final_proof.md. The judge stack uses this to align against the hidden gold proof graph held in judge/vault/.

schema_version.description: Schema version. Pinned so judges can branch on layout changes.

target_theorem.description: The harness's own statement of what it is trying to prove. Free-form mathematical English. Must reference dimension 3 and the Kakeya / Besicovitch set conjecture.

definitions.description: Definitions the proof relies on (e.g. δ-tube, broad tube family, Frostman measure).

pre_cutoff_dependencies.description: Every external mathematical fact used in the proof, citing its source. Sources MUST be in the time-capsule corpus.

arxiv_id.description: arXiv id of a corpus paper; e.g. 1909.10973v3.

new_lemmas.description: Lemmas / propositions the harness introduces. The judge stack compares this list against the hidden gold proof graph.

proof_pointer.description: Section or line range in final_proof.md where the lemma is proved.

depends_on.description: Names of other definitions / lemmas / corpus citations.

used_for.description: Names of downstream lemmas or the final implication consuming this lemma.

known_gaps.description: Self-reported gaps. Reporting gaps is rewarded by the rubric; hiding them is penalised when the adversarial judge finds them.

final_implication.description: How the lemma chain implies Minkowski and Hausdorff dimension 3 for every Kakeya set in R^3.
